trello.name: Fix Android photo upload crash on Android 14
trello.desc: Resolve NullPointerException in media picker callback when user backgrounds app mid-upload. Top Android crasher ~4% of Android sessions. Repro: start photo upload, background app before finish, return to app. Owner Marcus requested fix and verification by Wednesday to allow QA time before Aug 20 mobile release. Sam to confirm fix on Android 14 test devices and add to regression run. Sprint Aug 10-21, mobile release Aug 20, demo Aug 21. Elena out Aug 17-18, plan reviews around absence. Interviews for second backend role ongoing, no action required from team this sprint. Task is launch critical for clean release.

trello.name: Verify Android photo upload crash fix on Android 14 test devices
trello.desc: QA verification of Marcus's crash fix. Confirm fix on Android 14 test devices and add to regression run. Due by Wednesday Aug 13 to allow time before Aug 20 release. Owner Sam.

trello.name: Build backend sync API for offline notes list
trello.desc: Implement sync endpoint for enterprise offline mode promise. Client sends last-synced timestamp, server returns delta of created, updated, and deleted notes. Conflict resolution is last-write-wins for this pass, no merge UI. Owner Elena. API should be in review before Elena is out Aug 17-18. Sprint Aug 10-21, release Aug 20.

trello.name: Implement client offline mode for notes list
trello.desc: Client side offline support for notes list. Use Room local cache, queue writes while offline, replay when connectivity returns. Acceptance criteria: app can be opened in airplane mode, notes visible, edits made offline, reconcile on reconnect with no data loss. Owner Marcus. Acceptance criteria to be written into ticket as discussed. Sprint Aug 10-21, release Aug 20.

trello.name: Migrate CI pipelines from Jenkins to GitHub Actions
trello.desc: Jenkins fell over twice last week, team lacks plugin maintenance knowledge. Complete migration: finish test and release pipelines in GitHub Actions, keep nightly build schedule. Run Jenkins and GitHub Actions in parallel for one week before turning Jenkins off. Keep Jenkins alive until parallel week is clean. Proof of concept for build job already exists. Owner Sam. Sprint Aug 10-21.

trello.name: Add per-user rate limiting to search endpoint
trello.desc: Post-incident hardening after search endpoint degradation from misbehaving script. Add per-user rate limit 100 requests per minute per user, return HTTP 429 with Retry-After header when exceeded. Add metrics counter to observe limit hits. Owner Elena. Sprint Aug 10-21.

trello.name: Update privacy policy consent screen for GDPR compliance
trello.desc: Legal flagged consent screen non-compliant for EU launch. Update privacy policy screen so consent is opt-in with separate toggles for analytics and marketing, not a single pre-checked box. Must be in Aug 20 release, launch blocker. Marcus to get new copy from legal and rebuild screen. Owner Marcus. Due Aug 20.

trello.name: Write automated regression tests for payments flow
trello.desc: Payments flow has no automated coverage and burned team in last release. Create regression tests for purchase, restore, cancellation, and receipt validation path. Tests should run in CI as part of new GitHub Actions pipeline. Owner Sam. Sprint Aug 10-21, release Aug 20.
